work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Your effort going unseen
work.body: Helpfulness often goes unnoticed. Say what you did in one plain sentence.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Yes to the small favor
work.body: Small favors add up to a second job. Go easy: say 'I can do that next week'.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Fussing over the unasked detail
work.body: Attention to the small thing can become meddling. Ask whether it matters to the person it is for.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Advice before they ask
relationships.body: A 6 day tends to turn care into suggestions. Ask 'advice or just company?' first.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: A quiet count of who gave more
relationships.body: You may notice a tally building. Go easy: say what you need in one plain sentence.
relationships.link: the 6's resentment when care is not returned

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Fixing instead of hearing
relationships.body: Solving a problem can feel like love and can skip the listening. Ask one more question.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Adjusting yourself to their mood
relationships.body: You may shape yourself to everyone else's mood. Notice which feelings are yours.
relationships.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Hovering nearby
relationships.body: It is easy to stand close in case you are needed. Go easy: step back for an hour.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Waiting for thanks
relationships.body: Unspoken expectations of thanks can sour a kindness. Give without a ledger.
relationships.link: the 6's resentment when care is not returned

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Running on empty for others
energy.body: A 6 day can make your own needs feel optional. Put thirty minutes in the diary that are only yours.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Hosting past your limit
energy.body: Welcoming people is a gift and can wear you thin. Go easy: pick the one thing you want.
energy.link: the 6's wish to look after everyone

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Carrying the household alone
energy.body: Quiet effort can look like devotion and tends to exhaust. Ask someone to own one chore.
energy.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Rest last on the list
energy.body: You may notice your rest is the first thing to go. Do it first today.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Everyone fed but you
energy.body: You may notice you reach for comfort food when you have given everything away. Make something comforting for yourself first.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Guilt for stopping
energy.body: Resting can feel like letting people down. Tell someone you are off duty and keep to it.
energy.link: the 6's guilt about not doing enough

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: The ideal home in your head
mind.body: A 6 day tends to compare the home and the meal with an ideal. Name one thing that was good enough.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Guessing what they need
mind.body: It is easy to act before anyone has asked. Go easy: ask once.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Calling your rest selfish
mind.body: Rest can feel undeserved when others are busy. A rested carer often helps more than a tired one.
mind.link: the 6's guilt about not doing enough

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: A worry that is not yours
mind.body: You may notice concerns that belong to someone else. Write one down and ask if it is yours to act on.
mind.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: A long review of a small slip
mind.body: A 6 day can turn a small mistake into a long review. Go easy: say what you would say to a friend.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Needing to be needed
mind.body: Being needed can feel like worth, and it can wear you out. Teach someone one small task.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Comparing a small buy for hours
money.body: A 7 day can turn a modest purchase into an afternoon of comparison. Give it thirty minutes, then choose.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Holding out for certainty
money.body: You may notice you wait until every unknown is answered. Go easy: write the three facts you need and decide when you have them.
money.link: the 7's habit of waiting for certainty

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Keeping a figure to yourself
money.body: Privacy is fine, and secrecy from those affected tends to build distance. Share one plain number.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Reading every offer as a trick
money.body: A 7 day can make each deal look like a trap. Check one claim properly.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Research with no decision
money.body: Reading more can feel productive and delay a choice. Go easy: write the choice and the time.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Admin pushed aside by big ideas
money.body: Thinking about large questions can push aside the small forms. Do one practical task first.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Working alone all day
work.body: A 7 day can make solitary focus feel ideal. Share what you have with one person.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Holding work until perfect
work.body: You may notice you wait to show anything. Go easy: share a rough version.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Studying instead of stepping
work.body: A thorough study can feel safe and delay a simple action. Write the next step in one sentence and do it.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: A cool answer to enthusiasm
work.body: A dry reaction can read as disapproval. Name one thing you like first.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Doubts kept in your head
work.body: Quiet concerns tend to grow when unspoken. Go easy: say one in a calm sentence.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: One more fact first
work.body: It is easy to think another fact would settle it. Set a time and decide on what you have.
work.link: the 7's habit of waiting for certainty

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Silent without explanation
relationships.body: You may notice you withdraw and others guess why. Send a short note: 'I need quiet for now.'

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: A message left waiting
relationships.body: A 7 day can drift from replies. Go easy: answer one waiting message.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Thoughts kept back from friends
relationships.body: Privacy is healthy and secrecy from those close tends to feel like distance. Tell one person something small and true.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: A wry line that sounds cold
relationships.body: A dry comment may be read as dismissal. Add a warm sentence after it.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Analyzing instead of listening
relationships.body: It is easy to read for meaning. Go easy: repeat what they said and ask if you got it right.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Unexplained quiet
relationships.body: Time alone is healthy; unexplained, it can look like rejection. Say when you plan to be back.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Thought loops after dark
energy.body: A 7 day tends to bring mental circling late on. Write the question on paper and park it.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: More solitude than restores
energy.body: Solitude helps and, in excess, can drain. Go easy: message one person for a short chat.

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Staying in with your thoughts
energy.body: Staying in can feel peaceful and tends to dull the mood. Take a ten-minute walk outside.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: A tired mind first
energy.body: You may notice your mind tires before your body. Switch to something with your hands.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Skipping the shared break
energy.body: Passing on group breaks can keep your energy and connections low. Go easy: join this one.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Absorbed past bedtime
energy.body: Absorbing study can cost rest. Set a time to close the book and keep it.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Holding out for a full answer
mind.body: A 7 day tends to wait for certainty. Write the best available answer and act on it.
mind.link: the 7's habit of waiting for certainty

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Skepticism going sour
mind.body: Doubt is useful and can slide into assuming the worst. Go easy: name one thing that might work.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Mistrusting a plain good thing
mind.body: A plain good result can look too easy to trust. Accept it for an hour before you look for the catch.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Studying a feeling
mind.body: You may notice you analyze a feeling instead of having it. Name it in one word.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Replaying what was said
mind.body: Going over a talk can feel like understanding. Go easy: pick one thing to ask next time.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: An idea kept private
mind.body: Good thinking often stays hidden. Share one idea with someone today, even if it is half formed.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Self-worth tied to a figure
money.body: An 8 day can tie self-respect to income or status. Name one thing you value that no figure shows.
money.link: the 8's habit of measuring worth by output

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Spending to show you are doing well
money.body: It is easy to buy the visible proof. Go easy: wait a day on any purchase meant mainly for display.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Holding every money choice
money.body: Controlling all the choices can feel like responsibility and tends to shut others out. Hand one over.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Counting who owes what
money.body: You may notice an exact tally of favors. Forgive one small debt aloud.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Extra hours for a target
money.body: Chasing a number can swallow the evening. Go easy: set the hours you give it.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: A gift heard as a debt
money.body: An 8 day tends to hear a kindness as an obligation. Say 'thank you' and stop there.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Another task on a full plate
work.body: Effort comes naturally on an 8 day and the load can keep growing. Drop one thing before you add one.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Doing every detail yourself
work.body: Control can look like competence and tends to slow a team. Go easy: delegate one task fully.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Rating people by results
work.body: Measuring colleagues by output can hide what they carry. Ask how someone is first.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: A sharp tone in a message
work.body: Pressure may sharpen your voice. When you notice it, wait a minute before you send.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: No stop time set
work.body: Without a limit, work tends to expand to fill everything. Go easy: set a finishing hour now.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Taking all the credit or blame
work.body: An 8 day tends to carry the outcome alone. Name one contributor and say what they did.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Running people like a project
relationships.body: You may notice you manage partners and friends like tasks. Ask what they would like first.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: A firm tone that lands hard
relationships.body: Stress can make you short. Go easy: say 'I am under pressure, not angry at you'.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Scorekeeping in a close bond
relationships.body: Tracking who did more tends to sour affection. Say one thing you appreciate first.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Rushing past a feeling
relationships.body: Feelings can look slow to an 8. Listen for two minutes without fixing.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Providing instead of being there
relationships.body: Providing is real care and can stand in for presence. Go easy: give twenty minutes with no agenda.
relationships.link: the 8's habit of showing care through work

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Setting everyone's speed
relationships.body: It is easy to expect everyone to match your pace. Ask what pace feels right to them.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Pushing past your limit
energy.body: 8 days lean on effort and control. Pick a stop time this morning and keep it, even if the list isn't done.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Rest as a prize
energy.body: You may notice rest feels like something to earn. Go easy: take a short break before the push.
energy.link: the 8's habit of measuring worth by output

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Letting work take the weekend
energy.body: A weekend task can become a habit. Keep one block free of work.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Running on pressure
energy.body: Stress can feel like energy for a while. Notice when it runs you and walk for ten minutes.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Skipping the break
energy.body: Skipped breaks tend to slow the afternoon. Go easy: take a real ten minutes.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Handling everyone's problems
energy.body: An 8 day can make you the one who handles everything. Ask one person to take one problem.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Grading the day by output
mind.body: You may notice the day gets scored on what it produced. Note one thing that mattered and produced nothing.
mind.link: the 8's habit of measuring worth by output

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: A critic that drives and belittles
mind.body: The voice that pushes you can also put you down. Go easy: speak to yourself as to a colleague.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Controlling every outcome
mind.body: Wanting certainty can feel like diligence and tends to exhaust. Name one thing out of your hands.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Impatient with a slower pace
mind.body: An 8 day tends to speed up as others slow. Ask what the slower pace protects.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Looking at who is ahead
mind.body: It is easy to measure yourself against others. Go easy: compare today with your own last week.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: A light hour feeling like failure
mind.body: You may notice slack time feels like falling behind. Plan one hour on purpose.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Giving beyond what you can spare
money.body: A 9 day can make generosity feel like duty. Decide your giving amount before you are asked.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Gifts spread too thin
money.body: Many small gifts can feel kind and are hard to track. Go easy: choose one cause to support well.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Giving until it sours
money.body: Giving beyond your means tends to turn into bitterness. If you notice the sourness, lower the amount.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Ignoring your own figures
money.body: Attention to others' needs can crowd out your own. Spend ten minutes on your accounts.
money.link: the 9's detachment from its own needs

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Holding on out of loyalty
money.body: You may keep something because ending it feels disloyal. Go easy: close one small thing.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Unpaid effort, quiet resentment
money.body: A 9 day tends to pull toward unpaid work. Name what you are giving and set a limit.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: A yes to every cause
work.body: A 9 day can draw you into every good project. Choose one and decline the rest kindly.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Tending what is finished
work.body: It is easy to keep tending something that is done. Go easy: write what finished means and close it.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Giving the credit away
work.body: Passing every compliment on can keep your work unseen. Say what you contributed.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Resentment about no thanks
work.body: You may notice resentment building when work goes unthanked. Ask for what you need.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: A cause that became a job
work.body: Extras can pile up. Go easy: set the hours you offer and write them down.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Distance when it turns personal
work.body: A wide view can slip into distance. When someone shares something sensitive, stay and listen.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Staying loyal past usefulness
relationships.body: A 9 day can keep you in something long after it works. Ask what you would need for it to work.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Giving without being asked how you are
relationships.body: Generosity can hide a wish to be asked. Go easy: state one need to someone close.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Withdrawing instead of speaking
relationships.body: Detachment can feel like calm and often hides hurt. Say what is bothering you in one sentence.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: An old hurt returning
relationships.body: You may notice a past grievance resurfacing. Write the story down, then decide whether you need it.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Loving someone's potential
relationships.body: It is easy to love what someone could be. Go easy: describe them as they are now.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Rescuing unasked
relationships.body: A 9 day pulls toward helping everyone. Ask 'what would help?' and let them answer.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Giving until empty
energy.body: A 9 day can drain you slowly. Decide what you can offer now and stop there.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: A cause with no off switch
energy.body: Worthy work can take every hour. Go easy: set a time when it stops.
energy.link: the 9's habit of living for a cause

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Putting everyone before you
energy.body: Putting everyone first can feel noble and tends to wear thin. Do one thing for yourself.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: A sadness skipped over
energy.body: Endings can bring a heaviness that is easy to push past. Sit with it for five minutes.
energy.link: the 9's detachment from its own feelings

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: No room for play
energy.body: A serious day can crowd out play. Go easy: add one small enjoyable thing.
energy.link: the 9's habit of living for a cause

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Carrying every ending
energy.body: A 9 day tends to bring closings. Mark one with a small ritual, then put it down.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Old hurts on repeat
mind.body: A 9 day can bring old grievances back. Ask whether it is still useful and write a line to set it down.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: A wide view, no starting point
mind.body: Seeing everything can make you unsure where to act. Go easy: choose one small thing that is yours.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Thinking nobody understands
mind.body: Feeling unseen can slide into bitterness. Tell one person what you wish they knew.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Your plans waiting on the cause
mind.body: You may notice your own plans waiting while the cause gets everything. Do one small personal thing now.
mind.link: the 9's habit of living for a cause

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Guilt about the undone
mind.body: It is easy to feel bad about unfinished things. Go easy: finish one and release one.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Standing apart from people
mind.body: A wide perspective can turn into distance. Share one personal thing with someone.
